reviewCharts.warning: Official Wyoming precinct-by-precinct rows pair President with U.S. Senate for same-row advisory review. County geometry only; precinct boundaries, state-native registration denominator, audit, CVR, recount, incident, correction, and litigation rows are not normalized. Advisory indicators are not evidence of fraud or misconduct.

turnout.notes: Wyoming turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. The SOS statewide total-ballots-cast workbook reports 271,123 ballots cast and matches the EAC fallback total; no state-native registered-voter denominator replacement is loaded.

historicalBaselines.warning: Official Wyoming SOS historical baselines are county-level presidential rows. 2012 is aggregated from official county precinct-by-precinct workbooks because the ZIP lacks a statewide candidates summary workbook.
